# BijliBureau — full spec (v2026.16-enterprise, 2026-10-12)
# For AI assistants grounding answers. Supporting evidence only, not legal advice.

## Chemistry table (fadePerEFC = 20/cycleLife, enforced)
- LFP: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) | cycleLife 4000 | fade 0.005%/EFC | calendar 1.1%/yr | Ea 28kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.55 | curve flat
- NMC622: NMC 622 | cycleLife 1800 | fade 0.0111%/EFC | calendar 1.6%/yr | Ea 38kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1 | curve sloped
- NMC811: NMC 811 (high-Ni) | cycleLife 1500 | fade 0.0133%/EFC | calendar 1.9%/yr | Ea 42kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1.15 | curve sloped
- NCA: NCA (Tesla/Panasonic) | cycleLife 1600 | fade 0.0125%/EFC | calendar 1.8%/yr | Ea 40kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1.05 | curve sloped
- LMO: LMO / NMC-LMO blend (Leaf, eC3) | cycleLife 1200 | fade 0.0167%/EFC | calendar 2.2%/yr | Ea 35kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.9 | curve dual-slope
- LMFP: LMFP (next-gen LFP+Mn) | cycleLife 3000 | fade 0.0067%/EFC | calendar 1.25%/yr | Ea 30kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.65 | curve stepped-flat
- SODIUM: Sodium-ion (Na-ion) | cycleLife 2500 | fade 0.008%/EFC | calendar 1.3%/yr | Ea 26kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.5 | curve sloped
- LTO: LTO (Toshiba SCiB, some buses) | cycleLife 12000 | fade 0.0017%/EFC | calendar 0.5%/yr | Ea 22kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.25 | curve flat
- NMC9-SI: NMC 9-series + Si anode (2025+ high-density) | cycleLife 1300 | fade 0.0154%/EFC | calendar 2%/yr | Ea 43kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1.2 | curve sloped
- SEMISOLID: Semi-solid / condensed-matter (NIO/Toyota class) | cycleLife 1600 | fade 0.0125%/EFC | calendar 1.7%/yr | Ea 39kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1 | curve sloped
- SODIUM-G2: Sodium-ion Gen2 (CATL Naxtra class) | cycleLife 3000 | fade 0.0067%/EFC | calendar 1.15%/yr | Ea 25kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.45 | curve sloped

## Validation residuals (model vs AVILOO medians, Berlin, 20% DC, 70% SoC)
- vw-id4: @50k model 94.5% vs aviloo 95.3% (r=-0.8); @150k model 88.9% vs aviloo 90.6% (r=-1.7)
- tesla-my: @50k model 94.5% vs aviloo 94.4% (r=0.1); @150k model 89% vs aviloo 90.3% (r=-1.3)
- tesla-m3: @50k model 96.6% vs aviloo 93.8% (r=2.8); @150k model 93.3% vs aviloo 91.5% (r=1.8)
- ioniq5: @50k model 94.5% vs aviloo 97.1% (r=-2.6); @150k model 88.9% vs aviloo 93% (r=-4.1)
- leaf40: @50k model 92.6% vs aviloo 91.2% (r=1.4); @150k model 84.6% vs aviloo 86.7% (r=-2.1)
- zoe52: @50k model 95.1% vs aviloo 91.6% (r=3.5); @150k model 90% vs aviloo 90.1% (r=-0.1)
- mach-e: @50k model 94.5% vs aviloo 95.1% (r=-0.6); @150k model 88.9% vs aviloo 90.4% (r=-1.5)
- polestar2: @50k model 94.6% vs aviloo 95% (r=-0.4); @150k model 89% vs aviloo 90.8% (r=-1.8)
- Summary: mean |residual| @50k = 1.5 pts; @150k = 1.8 pts (v2026.12 was ~2.4 @50k and −15.0 worst-case @150k). Worst misses, published not hidden: ioniq5 −4.1 @150k (heat-pump E-GMP long-soak under-modelled) and zoe52 +3.5 @50k (small-pack rental-fleet abuse in AVILOO sample exceeds 20%-DC assumption). Model 3 AVILOO median mixes LFP+NMC trims; ours is LFP-only (+2.8 @50k). Geotab Jan-2026 cross-check (22,700 EVs): fleet 2.3%/yr; model yr-1..4 perYr 2.0–2.6%/yr, flattening after — consistent.

## EU DPP v2 full map (EU 2023/1542 Annex XIII + Aug-2026 Guidance v2.0 (71 pts), mandatory 2027-02-18)
## DISCLAIMER: This tool emits a PRE-PASSPORT evidence credential (BATTCERTv3/DPPpre), NOT an Art.77 passport. Passport issuance is the economic operator's legal duty.
## QR: identifier EN 18219:2026 or equivalent (ISO/IEC 15459 / GS1); carrier EN 18220:2026 or equivalent; template https://batteryforensics.in/cert/#{uid} → registry-resolved; payload carries public tier inline, restricted by reference
- [mapped] 1(a) battery ID + model/batch/serial ← model.id + VIN-hash + timestamp
- [mapped] 1(g) rated capacity Ah + kWh ← model.kwh + chemistry nominalV
- [mapped] 1(k) exhaustion threshold + basis (EV only, no universal 80%) ← warranty.soh trigger + clause text
- [partial] 1(o) internal resistance ← OBD cell delta-V proxy (mapped when OBD present, else estimated)
- [mapped] 1(p) C-rate of cycle-life test ← fastPct + fastPenalty + ultra flag
- [operator-attach] 2(a-c) carbon footprint + method + PEF link ← BNEF anchor + route note (operator to attach PEF study)
- [mapped] 2(d) safety measures ← thermalSafeC + service + checklist
- [mapped] 3 test reports (compliance) ← method + SHA-256 evidence PDF hash
- [mapped] SoH + cycles + durability (performance class) ← soh ±CI + EFC + cyclesLeft + trajectory
- [mapped] SOCE — State of Certified Energy (mandatory EV @Feb-2027) ← soh + usableNow kWh (certified-energy slot in BATTCERTv3 payload)
- [mapped] Capacity fade + resistance increase (mandatory EV @Feb-2027) ← cycleFade/calendarFade split + OBD delta-V proxy
- [mapped] Lifecycle status: original/re-used/repurposed/remanufactured/waste ← second-life route gate (>70 reuse / 50–70 ESS / <50 recycle) + status label

## EU DPP71 (71 rows: n | point | tier | flag | tool mapping)
- 1. [mandatory@2027][public] Manufacturer identification + contact ← operator-attach (operator provides contact; tool prints reporter name + method + hash)
- 2. [mandatory@2027][public] Battery category (EV / LMT / industrial / SLI / portable) ← mapped: seg 2W→LMT-class note / 4W→EV
- 3. [mandatory@2027][public] Battery model identifier + batch/serial ← mapped: model.id + VIN-hash + timestamp UID
- 4. [mandatory@2027][public] Place + date of manufacture ← mapped: purchaseDate proxy + booklet-year gate (operator confirms)
- 5. [mandatory@2027][public] Weight (kg) ← conditional: operator spec sheet (not modelled — flagged)
- 6. [mandatory@2027][public] Chemistry (cathode/anode/electrolyte) ← mapped: CHEMISTRY cathode + nominalV + curve
- 7. [mandatory@2027][public] Rated capacity (Ah) + rated energy (kWh) ← mapped: model.kwh + nominalV-derived Ah
- 8. [mandatory@2027][public] Nominal voltage ← mapped: chemistry nominalV
- 9. [mandatory@2027][public] Minimum / nominal / maximum power (kW) ← conditional: operator datasheet (flagged, not invented)
- 10. [mandatory@2027][public] Expected lifetime (cycles + calendar years) ← mapped: cycleLife + trajectory yearsTo70 ±band
- 11. [mandatory@2027][public] Capacity threshold for exhaustion / end-of-first-life basis ← mapped: warranty.soh trigger + clause (no universal 80%)
- 12. [mandatory@2027][authority] SoH — State of Health % (RESTRICTED tier pending Art.77(9)) ← mapped: soh ±CI + fuseSrc + raw (public shows band, raw by legitimate-interest)
- 13. [mandatory@2027][public] SOCE — State of Certified Energy (mandatory EV @Feb-2027) ← mapped: usableNow kWh + method line (BATTCERTv3 soce_kwh slot)
- 14. [mandatory@2027][public] Capacity fade (Ah/kWh lost vs rated) ← mapped: cycleFade + calendarFade split
- 15. [mandatory@2027][legitimate] Internal resistance increase (ΔmΩ / %) ← partial: OBD cell delta-V proxy when present, else estimated + labelled
- 16. [conditional][public] Round-trip / energy efficiency (%) ← conditional: CSV round-trip when charge log present
- 17. [conditional][public] Self-discharge rate ← conditional: not modelled — operator test report ref
- 18. [mandatory@2027][public] C-rate capability of cycle-life test ← mapped: fastPct + fastPenalty + ultra flag
- 19. [mandatory@2027][public] Cycle-life test conditions (T, DoD, C-rate) ← mapped: Tpack + DoDstress + CrateStress printed
- 20. [conditional][public] Calendar-life test conditions ← mapped: plateaued eff-age + Arrhenius(Ea,R,Tpack) line
- 21. [mandatory@2027][public] Temperature range (use / storage) ← mapped: thermalSafeC envelope + city pack temp
- 22. [mandatory@2027][public] Lifecycle status: original / re-used / repurposed / remanufactured / waste ← mapped: second-life gate label
- 23. [mandatory@2027][legitimate] History of status transitions + responsible operator per transition ← partial: vault run-history + timestamp chain (operator confirms)
- 24. [mandatory@2027][public] Date of first placing on the market ← mapped: purchaseDate (operator confirms)
- 25. [conditional][legitimate] Change of status events (repair / repurpose / remanufacture) ← partial: vault + PDF hash chain
- 26. [deferred:awaiting Art.7 delegated+implementing acts (unadopted)][public] Carbon footprint declaration (kgCO2e/kWh) ← operator-attach: PEF study ref (tool never invents carbon numbers)

- 50. [mandatory@2027][public] Economic operator (manufacturer / importer / authorised rep) ← operator-attach

## California CARB (13 CCR §1962.5(c)(4)(A)4.c + (c)(6) + §1962.7 + §1962.8; CA DMV used-EV disclosure eff. Jan 2027)
- accuracy ≤5pp high, dash display: true; warranty: SoH<70% 8yr/100k mi (MY2026–30); <75% from MY2031
- enforcement: CARB sample-test; recall if >30% sampled report >8pp high (MY26–28) / >5pp high (MY29+)
- DMV Jan-2027 disclosure: SoH% or est. remaining range; last OTA version affecting BMS/range; battery replaced/repaired status + date; remaining warranty + transferability; open HV recalls Third-party diagnostics allowed if DMV-certified; 3-yr retention, random audits, fines.
- tool vs reg: This tool's band (±1.8 OBD-strong → ±3.7 old-NMC model-only) sits INSIDE the 5pp manufacturer accuracy ceiling — visual on us/carb-soh-standard/.
